annotations.text:
Drawn at 932x430 — the real logical size of your iPhone in landscape.

The hatched bands are the parts the phone takes back: the Dynamic Island gutter down the sides and the home indicator along the bottom. My earlier screenshots left these out, which is why previews looked roomier than the device.

Drag the Safe area sliders above the artboard if the real gutters look wider or narrower than this.

Updated to match your saved edits, now live in the app:

• The tall stats pill is gone — Sets and Days Active are separate small pills at the top and bottom of the right edge, so the middle of that edge (where the Dynamic Island lands in one rotation) stays clear. Total Reps is dropped in landscape only.
• Est. time / Focus rides the MONDAY + GYM row instead of costing a line.
• Shuffle and both pills clear the physical edge by 6px, and Shuffle is anchored above the home indicator.
